exposure: Ultrasound guided transversus abdominis plane (USG-TAP) block using 20 ml of 0.25% levobupivacaine
outcome: Verbal numerical rating pain scores (VNRS) at rest and coughing
Total amount of IV-PCA tramadol demand and consumption
Total amount of rescue analgesic demands
cohort: Seventy ASA I-II patients undergoing caesarean section following spinal anaesthesia were included.
finding: USG-TAP block significantly reduced postoperative pain scores and analgesic consumption, prolonged the time to first rescue analgesia, and improved patient satisfaction after caesarean delivery.
